name: act
description: Installs act, which runs GitHub Actions workflows locally, from its checksum-verified GitHub release archive; needs a Docker Engine the feature does not install.

version.description: act version to install: 'latest', or a release such as 0.2.89 (a leading 'v' is accepted; 0.2.23 or later).

defaultImage.description: Runner images to preselect in the remote user's ~/.config/act/actrc, as act's first-run prompt would: 'medium' (catthehacker/ubuntu:act-*), 'large' (catthehacker/ubuntu:full-*), or 'none' to write nothing.
